map.支持两种方法：直接选择 Prader 睾丸计比对所得体积，或用长、宽、高按椭球公: Supports two methods: pick the volume read directly from a Prader orchidometer, or compute it from length, width, and height with the ellipsoid formula (V = L × W × H × 0.71 / 1000, in mm). Left and right testicular volumes are output separately; the adult reference range is roughly 15–25 mL, and the result is for self-checking reference only.
map.方法一：Prader 睾丸计对比，选最接近的体积(1~25 mL): Method 1: Prader orchidometer comparison, pick the closest volume (1–25 mL)
map.方法二：椭球公式法，填长/宽/高(mm)自动计算: Method 2: ellipsoid formula, enter length/width/height (mm) and it computes automatically
map.分别输出左、右侧睾丸体积: Outputs left and right testicular volumes separately
map.标注成人参考范围约 15~25 mL: Marks the adult reference range of about 15–25 mL
map.生殖健康自查：估算睾丸体积是否在正常范围: Reproductive health self-check: estimate whether testicular volume is in the normal range
map.随访对比：记录两侧体积变化: Follow-up comparison: record changes in volume on both sides
map.科普学习：理解 Prader 法与椭球公式: Learning: understand the Prader method and the ellipsoid formula
map.选择测量方法（Prader 对比 / 椭球公式）: Choose a measurement method (Prader comparison / ellipsoid formula)
map.Prader 法：选左、右侧最接近的体积: Prader method: pick the closest volume for the left and right sides
map.公式法：填左、右侧的长/宽/高(mm): Formula method: enter the length/width/height (mm) for the left and right sides
map.点击「计算」得到左右侧体积与参考提示: Click "Compute" to get the left and right volumes with reference notes
map.椭球公式 V = 长×宽×高×0.71/1000，单位用 mm、结果 mL: Ellipsoid formula V = L × W × H × 0.71 / 1000, with mm as input units and mL as the result
map.Prader 法是临床常用对比法，需实际比对模型: The Prader method is a common clinical comparison approach and requires a physical model
map.成人参考约 15~25 mL，低于此提示就医评估: The adult reference is about 15–25 mL; below that, a medical evaluation is advised
map.本工具仅供自查，异常请找专科医生: This tool is for self-checking only; consult a specialist if anything is abnormal
map.两种方法有差异正常吗？: Is a Difference Between the Two Methods Normal?
map.测量与比对都有误差，轻微差异正常；差异大建议复查或就医。: Both measurement and comparison carry error, so small differences are normal; large differences suggest rechecking or seeing a doctor.
map.公式里的 0.71 是什么？: What Is the 0.71 in the Formula?
map.是椭球近似的经验系数（Lambert 公式），把三维尺寸折算成体积。: It is the empirical coefficient for the ellipsoid approximation (Lambert's formula), converting three dimensions into a volume.
